run_eval_gaussians: run eval_gaussians to compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics for a 3D Gaussian Splatting model on a test dataset
run_eval_gaussians_with_mesh: run eval_gaussians with save_mesh enabled to extract and save a triangle mesh from the TSDF voxel grid
run_eval_gaussians_with_rendering: run eval_gaussians with save_exr enabled to save rendered images as EXR files alongside metric computation
review_eval_gaussians_pose_interpolation: review eval_gaussians to understand how camera poses are interpolated between keyframes for non-keyframe test views
review_eval_gaussians_vignette_handling: review eval_gaussians to understand how vignette correction is applied to both rendered and ground truth images before metric computation
